Name: CHAOS_MATCHING_REPLACE_TREASURE_TABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Deep of Night treasure replacement. Each session draws one replacement group (range from ChaosMatchingReplaceTreasureCommon); every row of that group whose map is in the session marks up to ten of that map's treasures for replacement.

Fields.Name: Replacement Group
Fields.Description: The row applies only when the session's drawn replacement group equals this value. The group is drawn once per session between the minimum and maximum set in ChaosMatchingReplaceTreasureCommon. Retail: 1-5 (0 on the empty row 0).

Fields.Name: Site Map
Fields.Description: Map of the site whose treasures are replaced, as AABB (3410 = m34_10). The row applies only if the session placed this site. Use either this or Field Map, not both. 0: use Field Map.

Fields.Name: Site Variation
Fields.Description: Variation of the placed site the row applies to; -1 applies to every placed variation of the site map. Retail: -1 or 0-6.

Fields.Name: Field Map
Fields.Description: Open-field tile whose treasures are replaced, as 60XXYY (604339 = m60_43_39). With a Shifting Earth condition, the tile's Shifting Earth version is used (m60_43_39_10 for Mountaintop, _20 for The Crater...). Use either this or Site Map, not both. 0: use Site Map.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier
Fields.Description: The row applies only if this map-pattern modifier is active in the session; for a Shifting Earth modifier (11-15) the session's Shifting Earth must be that one. 0: no condition. Retail: 0, 11-15 (field tiles), 14 (Great Hollow sites).

Fields.Name: Treasure 1
Fields.Description: Number of a treasure in the map, combined with the map and the site variation into the treasure's ID. That treasure is marked for replacement in Deep of Night. -1: none. Retail: 10, 20... 250 and 270-350.

Fields.Name: Treasure 7
Fields.Description: As Treasure 1. -1: none. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Treasure 8
Fields.Description: As Treasure 1. -1: none. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Treasure 9
Fields.Description: As Treasure 1. -1: none. Retail: -1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Treasure 10
Fields.Description: As Treasure 1. -1: none. Retail: -1 on every row.
